title: Alpha and Omega
lead: The first and last letters of the Greek alphabet. In Revelation God says "I am the Alpha and the Omega" (Revelation 1:8; Revelation 21:6), and Jesus says the same of himself (Revelation 22:13), joining it to "the First and the Last", the LORD's own claim in Isaiah 41:4, Isaiah 44:6 and Isaiah 48:12. It is a way of saying: before everything, after everything, and everything in between.
